title: Installation in commercial garages and aircraft hangars.
officialText:
Unit heaters installed in garages for more than three motor vehicles
or in aircraft hangars shall be installed in accordance with Sections 305.9, 305.10 and 305.11.
SECTION FGC 621
UNVENTED ROOM HEATERS
